name: Lilith
source:
Self-described "topside goddess" who has a cult following of human and demon patrons. Her content can be described as "when occult meets femdom." She casts spells on people and makes them beg for her to revert them (in a consensual, sexy way).
While not able to cast spells herself, she has a familiar who helps her with the magic.

[From [url=https://welcometoheavenblog.com/succubussimulator/]official website[/url]]
